en.summary: Fixes raster-memory request generation by removing an illegal ready term from req_valid, restoring correct valid/ready behavior.
why_it_counts: The one-line change directly controls whether the raster unit issues memory requests.
Gating valid by ready is a classic functional handshake bug.
The patch is in DUT RTL, not in tests or infrastructure.
evidence: req_valid changes from mem_req_valid && mem_req_ready && |raster_rs_empty to mem_req_valid && |raster_rs_empty.
The modified signal is the request-valid input of VX_mem_streamer.
The commit message explicitly references the stall condition.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a valid/ready protocol, valid must indicate that work is available independent of the consumer's current readiness. If valid is gated by ready, the producer may only announce a request when the consumer is already ready, which can create self-suppressing behavior where a pending request is never held long enough to be accepted correctly.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: request valid generation under ready/valid protocol
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A raster or memory request is pending while the downstream request sink is not ready on the first eligible cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Add the downstream ready signal back into the req_valid expression so valid only asserts when ready is already high.
portability_notes: This is portable to any ready/valid request producer, not only raster logic.
The bug is especially harmful when the producer must hold valid until acceptance.
Apply the mutation at the valid-generation point, not in unrelated arbitration logic.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the combinational or sequential logic that generates a request valid signal for a ready/valid interface.
Identify the downstream ready signal for that same interface.
Conjoin ready into the valid condition so the producer advertises work only when the sink is already ready.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: req_valid input to raster_mem_streamer in VX_raster_mem
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes mem_req_ready from the req_valid expression passed into VX_mem_streamer.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_raster_mem, the req_valid argument to raster_mem_streamer changed from mem_req_valid && mem_req_ready && |raster_rs_empty to mem_req_valid && |raster_rs_empty.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Raster memory requests can be missed, over-stalled, or issued late because the producer no longer holds valid independently until the request is accepted.
evidence_for_injection: The bug fix is a single expression change on the request-valid signal.
The modified signal directly feeds VX_mem_streamer, which uses ready/valid semantics.
notes: This is a textbook ready/valid reinjection pattern and is highly portable across DUTs.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 raster 内存请求生成逻辑：从 req_valid 中删除了非法的 ready 项，恢复了正确的 valid/ready 语义。
why_it_counts: 这一行改动直接决定 raster 单元是否发出内存请求。
用 ready 去门控 valid 是典型的功能性握手错误。
补丁位于 DUT RTL，而不是测试或基础设施。
evidence: req_valid 从 mem_req_valid && mem_req_ready && |raster_rs_empty 改为 mem_req_valid && |raster_rs_empty。
被修改的信号是送入 VX_mem_streamer 的请求有效输入。
提交标题明确提到了 stall condition。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 valid/ready 协议中，valid 必须独立表示“当前有工作可做”，不能依赖消费者此刻是否 ready。如果 valid 被 ready 门控，生产者就只会在消费者已经 ready 时才宣布有请求，这会形成自抑制行为，使挂起请求无法被持续保持到真正被接受。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: ready/valid 协议下的请求 valid 生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 raster 或内存请求已经待发，但下游请求接收端在第一个可发周期并未 ready。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把下游 ready 信号重新加回 req_valid 表达式，使 valid 只有在 ready 已经为高时才拉起。
portability_notes: 该模式适用于任何基于 ready/valid 的请求生产者，而不仅限于 raster 逻辑。
当生产者需要把 valid 保持到请求被接受时，这种错误尤其致命。
应在生成 valid 的位置实施变异，而不是修改无关仲裁逻辑。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 ready/valid 接口上生成请求 valid 的组合或时序逻辑。
识别该接口对应的下游 ready 信号。
把 ready 与 valid 条件相与，使生产者只有在接收端已经 ready 时才宣告有工作。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_raster_mem 中 raster_mem_streamer 的 req_valid 输入
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复从传给 VX_mem_streamer 的 req_valid 表达式中移除了 mem_req_ready。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_raster_mem 中，raster_mem_streamer 的 req_valid 参数从 mem_req_valid && mem_req_ready && |raster_rs_empty 改为 mem_req_valid && |raster_rs_empty。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: raster 内存请求会因为 valid 不能独立保持到被接受而丢失、过度阻塞或延迟发出。
evidence_for_injection: 修复就是请求 valid 信号上的单表达式修改。
该信号直接馈入遵循 ready/valid 语义的 VX_mem_streamer。
提交没有触及其他无关文件。
notes: 这是 ready/valid 协议中很典型的回注模式，跨 DUT 可移植性很高。
